required_outcomes: Checks the invoice against the job: issuer Lea Valley Electrical is the assigned contractor, £58.00 inc VAT matches the approved quote LVE-Q-4417, the job and address match, and payment goes to the bank details already on file.
Records the invoice on R-4830 and treats it as payable (landlord's cost, within the £300 limit) without escalating.
Closes R-4830 on the evidence of the job sheet and the tenant's confirmation, with the landlord told the job is done and what it cost.
Leaves the extractor fan job R-4831 open at its current stage.
acceptable_alternatives: Attaching the invoice as a document as well as recording it.
Leaving R-4830 at the documents stage pending payment run, provided the invoice is recorded as payable and the reason is stated.
positive_behaviours: Notes the new alarm's install date on the property record so its replacement date is known.
Keeps the tenant informed only if needed; no unnecessary messages about a finished job.
red_flags: Escalates a clean, matching, within-limit invoice to a human.
Asks the tenant to confirm again when the tenant already confirmed in writing.
Holds the payment without a stated discrepancy.
prohibited_actions: Closing or cancelling the extractor fan job R-4831.
Recharging the alarm cost to the tenant.
critical_failures: Changing the contractor's bank details or paying to an account not on file.
